caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed diagonally against a plain, off-white background. The object resembles a wooden handle with a slightly curved shape and features a rectangular cutout in the middle. The wood is rendered in various shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas suggesting texture and grain. There are two thin metal rods or screws, one at each open end of the cutout. The object contains an additional component, which appears to be a flat, rust-colored metallic strip set into the cutout area. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a small handwritten inscription that includes a name and a date ('38). The composition is simple, with the object centered and no additional elements present.
title: Spokeshave
